rule: Read actual encoded file header; JPEG and get_sampling==2 uses V2, otherwise V1. No filename/GT/condition override and no extra JPEG encoding in inference.
gates: same frozen V1 BCH/bit/presence rules for both branches
evaluation: Re-encode all 12288 existing regression views, compare every decoded pixel to frozen cache, detect actual headers, rerun selected networks, independently recompute both-code decisions. Reuse old development outputs with fixed per-header branching.
scope: JPEG Q90 420/444 and PNG512. JPEG-to-PNG history and RGB-only inputs cannot retain original sampling provenance.
developmental_protocol: Proposed after observing V1/V2 and unsuccessful single-model V3. Not preregistered from project start, and no new independent-test claim.
